fullDescription: A neo-brutalist marketing page anchored on one audit-grade invoice data table: thick 3px black cell borders, an inverted black header row, squared status badges, right-aligned tabular-numeral money, and a bold total footer, all on off-white paper with a single acid-yellow accent, hard zero-blur offset shadows, and an Archivo-black + JetBrains-Mono type system.
prompt:
## Resumo
A brutalist marketing page for an AI data-table generator ('Ledger/01'), anchored on one hard-edged 'audit-grade' invoice table. The whole page is built from a thick 3px/4px black hairline grid on off-white paper with a single acid-yellow accent: a sticky bordered nav, a grid-paper hero with a giant uppercase headline (the word 'spine.' set in a black box on an acid highlight) and a 3-up stat strip, a black scrolling marquee, the showcase invoice table (black inverted header row, status-badge cells, tabular-numeral money column right-aligned, a bold black total footer), a dark 'schema' band of 3 enforced-rule cards plus an acid-bordered prompt.txt block, a 3-up pricing grid with one acid 'most picked' plan, a full-bleed acid CTA, and a footer. Everything is squared-off (no border radius) with hard offset drop-shadows (box-shadow x/y 0 black, sometimes doubled with acid) and JetBrains Mono labels over an Archivo black display face.

## Estilo Visual
Use a neo-brutalist swiss-grid design system. Page background warm off-white 'paper' #f4f1ea; primary text near-black 'ink' #0a0a0a; single accent 'acid' electric yellow #e8ff00. NOTHING is rounded (border-radius 0 everywhere). Every surface is a rectangle with a thick solid black border: 3px on cards/buttons/badges, 4px on the main table card and section bottom-borders, 2px on small status badges. Depth is HARD offset shadow only (zero blur): define .shadow-hard = 6px 6px 0 0 #0a0a0a, .shadow-hard-sm = 4px 4px 0 0 #0a0a0a, .shadow-hard-lg = 10px 10px 0 0 #0a0a0a, and a doubled .shadow-hard-acid = 6px 6px 0 0 #0a0a0a, 12px 12px 0 0 #e8ff00 for the prompt block. Two typefaces from Google Fonts: 'Archivo' (weights 400/600/700/800/900) as the display grotesk for huge UPPERCASE headlines (font-black, tracking-tight -0.02 to -0.03em, leading 0.86-0.92), and 'JetBrains Mono' (400/500/700/800) for EVERY label, button, badge, table cell, eyebrow and body line, always uppercase and letter-spacing 0.1-0.2em. Numbers and dates use font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums (.tnum) so columns align decimal over decimal. Background textures: a faint 28px hairline grid via linear-gradient(rgba(10,10,10,0.06) 1px lines) tiled 28px x 28px (.grid-bg) on the hero and pricing; solid black-fill bands (nav marquee, schema section, CTA) for rhythm. Accent discipline: acid-yellow only as a headline highlight box, the featured pricing card, one stat cell, the active 'Paid' status badge, marquee slash separators, the total-row sum figure, the prompt-block chrome, and the final CTA background. ::selection is background acid, color ink. Hover affordances are physical: buttons translate up (-translate-y-0.5 / -1) and/or swap to acid fill; table rows turn acid on hover (.cell-hover).

## Layout e Estrutura

### Sticky bordered nav
A `<header class="sticky top-0 z-50 bg-paper border-b-4 border-ink">` with an inner `mx-auto max-w-[1180px] px-5 md:px-8` and a `flex h-16 items-center justify-between` bar. Left: wordmark = a 36x36 (h-9 w-9) square grid tile (border-[3px] border-ink bg-acid shadow-hard-sm) holding a ph:grid-four-fill icon (width 20, text-ink), next to 'LEDGER/01' in font-mono text-[15px] font-extrabold uppercase tracking-[0.18em]. Center (hidden md:flex, gap-8, font-mono text-[12px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.16em]): The_Table / Schema / Pricing, each with a hover:bg-acid hover:px-1 inline highlight. Right: a CTA = border-[3px] border-ink bg-ink px-4 py-2 font-mono text-[12px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-paper shadow-hard-sm that on hover lifts (-translate-y-0.5) and swaps to bg-acid text-ink, reading 'Generate ->'.

### Grid-paper hero
A `relative overflow-hidden border-b-4 border-ink grid-bg` section, inner container py-16 md:py-24. Top: a flex-wrap row with an acid eyebrow pill (inline-flex items-center gap-2 border-[3px] border-ink bg-acid px-3 py-1.5 font-mono text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] shadow-hard-sm, with a 2x2 black square dot + 'Prompt . Data Table') beside a muted ref code 'REF // BRUTALIST TABLE 001' (font-mono text-[11px] text-ink/60). Headline: an `h1` font-grotesk font-black uppercase, leading-[0.86] tracking-[-0.03em], scaling text-[64px] -> sm:88 -> md:120 -> lg:140, reading 'Tables / with a / spine.' on three lines where the word 'spine.' is wrapped in `<span class="bg-acid px-2 shadow-hard-sm">`. Subhead: a max-w-[52ch] font-mono text-[15px] md:text-[17px] font-medium leading-relaxed text-ink/80 paragraph. CTA row (mt-10 flex flex-wrap gap-4): a primary 'See the table ->' (border-[3px] border-ink bg-ink px-7 py-4 font-mono text-[13px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-paper shadow-hard, hover -translate-y-1 + bg-acid text-ink) and a secondary 'Copy the prompt' (same box but bg-paper, hover bg-acid). Stat strip: a `mt-14 grid max-w-[760px] grid-cols-3 border-[3px] border-ink bg-paper shadow-hard` of three cells (first two border-r-[3px] border-ink, third bg-acid), each a big tabular-num figure (font-mono text-[30px] md:text-[38px] font-extrabold .tnum: '7', '0', '100%') over a tiny uppercase label (font-mono text-[10px] tracking-[0.16em] text-ink/60: 'Column types', 'Decimal drift', 'Tabular nums').

### Black scrolling marquee
A `border-b-4 border-ink bg-ink py-3 text-paper` full-bleed band containing a `flex overflow-hidden whitespace-nowrap` track. Inside, a `.marquee-track` (animation: marquee 22s linear infinite, translateX 0 to -50%) holds two identical (second aria-hidden) `flex shrink-0` runs of font-mono text-[13px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] phrases each in a px-6 span ('Invoice . Ledger', 'Tabular Numerals', 'Hard Shadows', 'Thick Borders', 'Uppercase Headers', 'No Em-Dashes') separated by an acid-colored '/' (text-acid).

### The Table (anchor showcase)
A `#table` section, border-b-4 border-ink, py-16 md:py-24. Section header: a `flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-end md:justify-between` row, left = a mono eyebrow '01 / Output' (text-[11px] tracking-[0.2em] text-ink/50) over an `h2` font-grotesk font-black uppercase leading-[0.92] tracking-[-0.02em] text-[34px] sm:44 md:62 'Recent Invoices'; right = two chips (a paper 'Q2 / 2026' and an acid '7 rows', each border-[3px] border-ink px-3 py-2 font-mono text-[11px] font-bold uppercase shadow-hard-sm). Then the TABLE CARD = a `mt-9 border-[4px] border-ink bg-paper shadow-hard-lg` wrapper with an inner `overflow-x-auto` holding a `w-full min-w-[640px] border-collapse text-left <table>` (see special components). Below: a `mt-4 font-mono text-[12px] font-medium uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-ink/50` caption 'A list of your recent invoices. Scroll horizontally on narrow screens.'.

### Schema dark band
A `#schema` section, border-b-4 border-ink bg-ink py-16 md:py-24 text-paper. Eyebrow '02 / Schema' in font-mono text-[11px] tracking-[0.2em] text-acid; H2 font-grotesk font-black uppercase max-w-[20ch] text-[30px] sm:42 md:62 'What the agent enforces'. Then a `mt-12 grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 border-[3px] border-paper` of three feature cells (dividers border-paper, p-7), each an acid Phosphor icon (width 30: ph:rows-fill, ph:number-square-one-fill, ph:text-aa-fill) over a font-mono text-[15px] font-extrabold uppercase title ('Hard Grid', 'Tabular Nums', 'Loud Headers') and a font-mono text-[13px] leading-relaxed text-paper/70 paragraph. Then the prompt block: a `mt-12 border-[3px] border-acid bg-ink shadow-hard-acid` panel with an acid title bar (flex justify-between border-b-[3px] border-acid bg-acid px-5 py-3: 'prompt.txt' in text-ink font-extrabold + 'copy ->>' in text-ink/70) above a `<pre>` (overflow-x-auto px-5 py-5 font-mono text-[13px] leading-relaxed text-paper) whose first character is an acid '>' prompt glyph, holding the multi-line example prompt.

### Pricing grid + acid CTA + footer
A `#pricing` section, border-b-4 border-ink grid-bg py-16 md:py-24: a header row (eyebrow '03 / Plans' + H2 'Pick a lane' font-grotesk font-black uppercase, with a muted mono support line on the right), then a `mt-12 grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-7` of three plan cards. Side cards = border-[3px] border-ink bg-paper p-7 shadow-hard hover:-translate-y-1 ('Draft $0/mo', 'Audit $80/mo') with a mono plan label, a font-grotesk text-[52px] font-black .tnum price + '/mo', a font-mono text-[13px] feature list using ph:check-bold / ph:x-bold (x items text-ink/40), and a bottom ghost button (border-[3px] border-ink bg-paper shadow-hard-sm hover:bg-acid). Middle FEATURED card = bg-acid shadow-hard-lg with an absolute -top-4 left-7 black 'Most picked' tag (border-[3px] border-ink bg-ink text-paper shadow-hard-sm) and a solid ink 'Go Ledger ->' button. Then a full-bleed `border-b-4 border-ink bg-acid py-20 md:py-28 text-center` CTA: an H2 font-grotesk font-black uppercase text-[34px] sm:52 md:84 'Describe a row. / Ship the table.' + a black pill 'Open the canvas ->' (border-[3px] border-ink bg-ink px-9 py-5 text-paper shadow-hard hover:-translate-y-1). Footer: a bg-paper py-12 row (flex-col md:flex-row justify-between) with the square acid wordmark tile + 'Ledger/01' and a muted mono 'Prompt Library . Data Table . 2026' line.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Componente
A `w-full min-w-[640px] border-collapse text-left <table>` inside an overflow-x-auto, border-[4px] border-ink card with shadow-hard-lg. THEAD: one `bg-ink text-paper` row of <th> = font-mono text-[12px] font-extrabold uppercase tracking-[0.16em], px-5 py-4, columns Invoice / Status / Method / Issued / Amount, each separated by a faint border-r-[3px] border-paper/20, the Amount header text-right. TBODY: font-mono text-[14px] font-medium rows, each `<tr class="cell-hover border-t-[3px] border-ink transition-colors">` (hover turns the row bg-acid; one row is pre-highlighted bg-acid/20). Cells are border-r-[3px] border-ink px-5 py-4: the invoice id is font-bold (INV-001..007), the date cell is .tnum text-ink/70 (e.g. '04 APR'), and the Amount cell is the last (no right border) px-5 py-4 text-right font-bold .tnum money ($250.00 .. $300.00). TFOOT: one `border-t-[4px] border-ink bg-ink text-paper` total row = a colspan-3 'Total / 7 invoices' label (font-mono text-[12px] font-extrabold uppercase tracking-[0.16em]), a right-aligned 'Sum' mini label (text-paper/60), and a right-aligned font-mono text-[18px] font-extrabold .tnum text-acid sum '$2,250.00'.

### Componente
An inline-flex items-center gap-2 border-[2px] border-ink px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.1em] mono pill (NOT rounded), with a leading 1.5x1.5 (h-1.5 w-1.5) square dot, in three states encoding payment: PAID = bg-acid with a solid black (bg-ink) dot; PENDING = bg-paper with a hollow dot (h-1.5 w-1.5 border-[1.5px] border-ink); UNPAID = bg-ink text-paper with an acid (bg-acid) dot. Used inside the table's Status column.

### Componente
A reusable zero-blur offset-shadow utility set that gives the whole page its physical depth: .shadow-hard-sm = 4px 4px 0 0 #0a0a0a (badges, chips, the nav CTA, small buttons), .shadow-hard = 6px 6px 0 0 #0a0a0a (hero CTAs, the stat strip, plan cards), .shadow-hard-lg = 10px 10px 0 0 #0a0a0a (the main table card, the featured plan), and a layered .shadow-hard-acid = 6px 6px 0 0 #0a0a0a, 12px 12px 0 0 #e8ff00 (the schema prompt block, so it casts a black THEN an acid offset). Hover states physically lift the element with -translate-y-0.5 to -1 instead of changing the shadow.

### Componente
A `.grid-bg` background texture used on the hero and pricing sections: two layered linear-gradients drawing a 1px hairline grid in rgba(10,10,10,0.06) (one to-right, one to-bottom) on a 28px x 28px tile, over the #f4f1ea paper. Reads as engineering graph paper and reinforces that 'the grid is the design'.

### Componente
A copy-the-prompt panel = border-[3px] border-acid bg-ink with the layered .shadow-hard-acid; a top chrome bar that is fully bg-acid (border-b-[3px] border-acid, px-5 py-3) carrying 'prompt.txt' (text-ink font-extrabold uppercase tracking-[0.16em]) on the left and 'copy ->>' (text-ink/70) on the right; below it a `<pre class="overflow-x-auto px-5 py-5 font-mono text-[13px] leading-relaxed text-paper">` whose leading character is an acid '>' glyph, holding the example generation prompt wrapped across lines.

## Notas Especiais
Stack: Tailwind via CDN with a custom theme (colors paper #f4f1ea, ink #0a0a0a, acid #e8ff00; fontFamily mono = 'JetBrains Mono', grotesk = 'Archivo'), Google Fonts 'Archivo' (400/600/700/800/900) + 'JetBrains Mono' (400/500/700/800), and Phosphor icons via Iconify iconify-icon (icons used: ph:grid-four-fill, ph:rows-fill, ph:number-square-one-fill, ph:text-aa-fill, ph:check-bold, ph:x-bold). Custom CSS utilities: .shadow-hard (6px 6px 0 ink), .shadow-hard-sm (4px 4px), .shadow-hard-lg (10px 10px), .shadow-hard-acid (6px 6px ink + 12px 12px acid); .grid-bg (28px hairline graph-paper grid in rgba(10,10,10,0.06)); .tnum (font-variant-numeric tabular-nums); .marquee-track (translateX 0 to -50% over 22s linear infinite) with a @keyframes marquee; .cell-hover:hover { background: #e8ff00 } for table rows; ::selection { background #e8ff00; color #0a0a0a }; html { scroll-behavior: smooth }. Layout tokens: every section is full-bleed with a 4px black bottom border and an inner mx-auto max-w-[1180px] px-5 md:px-8 container; sticky nav is h-16, z-50. Key techniques to preserve: (1) NO border radius anywhere, thick 2/3/4px solid black rules as the only structure; (2) hard ZERO-blur offset shadows (never soft/blurred) layered black-then-acid on the prompt block; (3) a strict two-type system, Archivo black for giant uppercase tracking-tight display + JetBrains Mono uppercase tracked-out for all labels/cells; (4) tabular-nums on every money/date so the table columns align decimal over decimal; (5) the invoice table is a real <table> (thead bg-ink inverted, 3px ink cell borders, right-aligned .tnum money column, a bold bg-ink tfoot total with the sum in acid) wrapped in overflow-x-auto with min-w-[640px] so it scrolls horizontally on narrow screens rather than reflowing; (6) acid-yellow #e8ff00 is rationed to highlight moments only (headline word box, featured plan, one stat cell, active 'Paid' badge, marquee slashes, total sum, prompt chrome, CTA band).

style.description: A neo-brutalist / swiss-grid aesthetic on warm off-white 'paper' (#f4f1ea) with near-black 'ink' (#0a0a0a) and a single electric acid-yellow accent (#e8ff00). The look is loud and structural: the grid IS the design. Money and dates use tabular-nums so columns line up to the pixel. Two faint background textures: a 28px black hairline grid (.grid-bg) on the hero and pricing sections, and full black-fill bands (nav-marquee, schema, CTA) for rhythm. Text selection is acid-on-ink.

prompts.prompt: A `#pricing` section, border-b-4 border-ink grid-bg py-16 md:py-24: a header row (eyebrow '03 / Plans' + H2 'Pick a lane' font-grotesk font-black uppercase, with a muted mono support line on the right), then a `mt-12 grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-7` of three plan cards. Side cards = border-[3px] border-ink bg-paper p-7 shadow-hard hover:-translate-y-1 ('Draft $0/mo', 'Audit $80/mo') with a mono plan label, a font-grotesk text-[52px] font-black .tnum price + '/mo', a font-mono text-[13px] feature list using ph:check-bold / ph:x-bold (x items text-ink/40), and a bottom ghost button (border-[3px] border-ink bg-paper shadow-hard-sm hover:bg-acid). Middle FEATURED card = bg-acid shadow-hard-lg with an absolute -top-4 left-7 black 'Most picked' tag (border-[3px] border-ink bg-ink text-paper shadow-hard-sm) and a solid ink 'Go Ledger ->' button. Then a full-bleed `border-b-4 border-ink bg-acid py-20 md:py-28 text-center` CTA: an H2 font-grotesk font-black uppercase text-[34px] sm:52 md:84 'Describe a row. / Ship the table.' + a black pill 'Open the canvas ->' (border-[3px] border-ink bg-ink px-9 py-5 text-paper shadow-hard hover:-translate-y-1). Footer: a bg-paper py-12 row (flex-col md:flex-row justify-between) with the square acid wordmark tile + 'Ledger/01' and a muted mono 'Prompt Library . Data Table . 2026' line.

special_ui_components.prompt: A `w-full min-w-[640px] border-collapse text-left <table>` inside an overflow-x-auto, border-[4px] border-ink card with shadow-hard-lg. THEAD: one `bg-ink text-paper` row of <th> = font-mono text-[12px] font-extrabold uppercase tracking-[0.16em], px-5 py-4, columns Invoice / Status / Method / Issued / Amount, each separated by a faint border-r-[3px] border-paper/20, the Amount header text-right. TBODY: font-mono text-[14px] font-medium rows, each `<tr class="cell-hover border-t-[3px] border-ink transition-colors">` (hover turns the row bg-acid; one row is pre-highlighted bg-acid/20). Cells are border-r-[3px] border-ink px-5 py-4: the invoice id is font-bold (INV-001..007), the date cell is .tnum text-ink/70 (e.g. '04 APR'), and the Amount cell is the last (no right border) px-5 py-4 text-right font-bold .tnum money ($250.00 .. $300.00). TFOOT: one `border-t-[4px] border-ink bg-ink text-paper` total row = a colspan-3 'Total / 7 invoices' label (font-mono text-[12px] font-extrabold uppercase tracking-[0.16em]), a right-aligned 'Sum' mini label (text-paper/60), and a right-aligned font-mono text-[18px] font-extrabold .tnum text-acid sum '$2,250.00'.

An inline-flex items-center gap-2 border-[2px] border-ink px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.1em] mono pill (NOT rounded), with a leading 1.5x1.5 (h-1.5 w-1.5) square dot, in three states encoding payment: PAID = bg-acid with a solid black (bg-ink) dot; PENDING = bg-paper with a hollow dot (h-1.5 w-1.5 border-[1.5px] border-ink); UNPAID = bg-ink text-paper with an acid (bg-acid) dot. Used inside the table's Status column.

A reusable zero-blur offset-shadow utility set that gives the whole page its physical depth: .shadow-hard-sm = 4px 4px 0 0 #0a0a0a (badges, chips, the nav CTA, small buttons), .shadow-hard = 6px 6px 0 0 #0a0a0a (hero CTAs, the stat strip, plan cards), .shadow-hard-lg = 10px 10px 0 0 #0a0a0a (the main table card, the featured plan), and a layered .shadow-hard-acid = 6px 6px 0 0 #0a0a0a, 12px 12px 0 0 #e8ff00 (the schema prompt block, so it casts a black THEN an acid offset). Hover states physically lift the element with -translate-y-0.5 to -1 instead of changing the shadow.

A `.grid-bg` background texture used on the hero and pricing sections: two layered linear-gradients drawing a 1px hairline grid in rgba(10,10,10,0.06) (one to-right, one to-bottom) on a 28px x 28px tile, over the #f4f1ea paper. Reads as engineering graph paper and reinforces that 'the grid is the design'.

A copy-the-prompt panel = border-[3px] border-acid bg-ink with the layered .shadow-hard-acid; a top chrome bar that is fully bg-acid (border-b-[3px] border-acid, px-5 py-3) carrying 'prompt.txt' (text-ink font-extrabold uppercase tracking-[0.16em]) on the left and 'copy ->>' (text-ink/70) on the right; below it a `<pre class="overflow-x-auto px-5 py-5 font-mono text-[13px] leading-relaxed text-paper">` whose leading character is an acid '>' glyph, holding the example generation prompt wrapped across lines.

structured.special_notes: Stack: Tailwind via CDN with a custom theme (colors paper #f4f1ea, ink #0a0a0a, acid #e8ff00; fontFamily mono = 'JetBrains Mono', grotesk = 'Archivo'), Google Fonts 'Archivo' (400/600/700/800/900) + 'JetBrains Mono' (400/500/700/800), and Phosphor icons via Iconify iconify-icon (icons used: ph:grid-four-fill, ph:rows-fill, ph:number-square-one-fill, ph:text-aa-fill, ph:check-bold, ph:x-bold). Custom CSS utilities: .shadow-hard (6px 6px 0 ink), .shadow-hard-sm (4px 4px), .shadow-hard-lg (10px 10px), .shadow-hard-acid (6px 6px ink + 12px 12px acid); .grid-bg (28px hairline graph-paper grid in rgba(10,10,10,0.06)); .tnum (font-variant-numeric tabular-nums); .marquee-track (translateX 0 to -50% over 22s linear infinite) with a @keyframes marquee; .cell-hover:hover { background: #e8ff00 } for table rows; ::selection { background #e8ff00; color #0a0a0a }; html { scroll-behavior: smooth }. Layout tokens: every section is full-bleed with a 4px black bottom border and an inner mx-auto max-w-[1180px] px-5 md:px-8 container; sticky nav is h-16, z-50. Key techniques to preserve: (1) NO border radius anywhere, thick 2/3/4px solid black rules as the only structure; (2) hard ZERO-blur offset shadows (never soft/blurred) layered black-then-acid on the prompt block; (3) a strict two-type system, Archivo black for giant uppercase tracking-tight display + JetBrains Mono uppercase tracked-out for all labels/cells; (4) tabular-nums on every money/date so the table columns align decimal over decimal; (5) the invoice table is a real <table> (thead bg-ink inverted, 3px ink cell borders, right-aligned .tnum money column, a bold bg-ink tfoot total with the sum in acid) wrapped in overflow-x-auto with min-w-[640px] so it scrolls horizontally on narrow screens rather than reflowing; (6) acid-yellow #e8ff00 is rationed to highlight moments only (headline word box, featured plan, one stat cell, active 'Paid' badge, marquee slashes, total sum, prompt chrome, CTA band).
